full_prompt_en: A square desaturated documentary photograph shows an isolated weathered two-story house pressed against an enormous pale boulder beneath a heavy gray sky. The house sits precisely in the center, facing the camera with a small wooden door at the top of straight steps. Three narrow upper windows line the facade, and two lower openings appear boarded or closed. A short balcony-like projection breaks the otherwise flat front wall. The huge mottled rock rises immediately behind and around the roofline, making the modest building look trapped against it. Loose stones and rubble gather along the base on both sides. A rust-red old truck is parked beside the house on the left, its dark cab and boxy rear partly hidden by the rock. On the right, a single leafless tree stands in a square planter, its bare branches thin against the clouded sky. A wide unpaved gray foreground separates the viewer from the building, with only a few scattered stones and subtle tire or surface marks. The far distance is nearly empty, dissolving into pale cold haze. Light is flat and overcast, with soft shadows under the balcony and in the doorway but no strong highlights. Dusty gray, chalk white and faint rust red keep the color almost monochrome. The photograph retains rough concrete, chipped plaster, rock texture and gravel detail without beautifying them. No people or readable text appear. The overall composition is bleak and exact, balancing a centered small structure against the oversized natural mass and broad empty ground.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形低饱和纪实照片呈现一幢孤立、磨旧的两层房屋，紧贴巨大浅色岩石，头顶是厚重灰天。房子精确居中正对镜头，一扇小木门位于直台阶顶端。上层三扇窄窗排列立面，下层两处开口似乎被封住或关闭。一处短阳台般突起打断原本平坦的正墙。巨大的斑驳岩石紧在屋顶后方和两侧升起，让小房子看似被它挤住。松散石块与瓦砾聚在底部两边。左侧停着一辆锈红旧卡车，深色驾驶室和箱状车厢部分被岩石遮住。右侧，一棵落叶树立在方形花池中，裸枝在云天前显得纤细。宽阔未铺装灰色前景隔开观者与房屋，仅有几块散石和浅淡轮胎或地表痕迹。远处几乎空无一物，消散在苍白冷雾里。光线平坦阴沉，阳台下与门内有柔影，却没有强烈高光。灰尘般的灰、粉笔白与微弱锈红让色彩近乎单色。照片保留粗糙混凝土、脱落灰泥、岩石肌理和砂砾细节，没有美化它们。画面没有人物或可读文字。整体构图荒凉而精确，以居中的小型人工结构对照过大的自然体量和宽阔空地。
style_prompt_en: A desaturated documentary-photography treatment compresses color into chalk gray, cold off-white, taupe and one faint rust accent. Diffuse overcast light leaves soft, shallow shadows and exposes every rough material surface evenly. A modest centered mass is dwarfed by a much larger surrounding volume, while a broad empty lower field intensifies isolation. Edges remain clear in the near-middle distance but fade into cold haze toward the horizon. Chipped, granular and weathered textures carry more visual weight than ornament or saturated color. The composition is frontal, still and severe, using scale disparity and restrained tonal variation to create a quiet sense of abandonment.
style_prompt_zh: 低饱和纪实摄影处理把色彩压缩为粉笔灰、冷灰白、灰褐与一处微弱锈色重音。阴天漫射光留下柔浅阴影，并均匀揭示每种粗糙材料表面。一块居中的中小体量被周围更大体积压住，宽阔空旷的下部色域加强孤立感。中近景边缘清楚，到地平线附近则淡入冷雾。脱落、颗粒与磨旧肌理比装饰或饱和色更有视觉重量。构图正面、静止而严峻，用尺度悬殊与克制明度变化制造安静的废弃感。
theme_en: An isolated worn house pressed against a huge boulder beneath a heavy gray sky
theme_zh: 厚重灰天下，一幢孤立旧屋紧靠巨大岩石
name: Tamas Dezso
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
